description: The chiller plant sequencer with the CHW differential-pressure and bypass PIDs and their set points. Its reads and writes are ControlBindings; it has no physical ports.

halt.description: The controller halts: its outputs hold their last values until it is reset.

name: Chiller plant controller

chw_dp_set.description: Index-circuit differential-pressure set point for the secondary pump.

chw_supply_temp_set.description: Plant CHW supply set point (site data: plant-design.json basis.capacities: CHW 14 / 20 degC).

duty_chillers.description: Chillers in duty; the rest are standby (site data: plant-design.json basis.capacities: 3 duty + 1 standby).

stage_down_load_fraction.description: Stage a chiller off below this load.

stage_up_load_fraction.description: Stage another chiller when running chillers exceed this load.
